review: 3.1.1 is a security patch for the published 3.0.1 and 3.1.0 lines. It updates symfony/mime and its polyfills to address CVE-2026-45070, and carries the 3.1.0 ContentAudit and block editor changes without converting stored block payloads. Existing projects keep their selected modules, themes, custom blocks and local dependency customisations. Review the source proposal and resolve local customisations before deployment.
